title: Bonovela Content Integrity, Quality Control & Zero-Tolerance Policy

blocks.text: Important Notice: Bonovela Content Integrity, Quality Control & Zero-Tolerance Policy
Effective Immediately — Applicable to All Contracted Authors and Published Books
Bonovela is committed to maintaining a professional publishing environment built on originality, creativity, writing quality, intellectual property protection, and reader satisfaction.

Every author publishing on Bonovela is expected to uphold these standards. Signing a publishing contract with Bonovela means accepting the platform's content policies, editorial requirements, originality standards, and enforcement procedures.

Bonovela operates a strict content monitoring and quality assurance system. All published books, chapters, manuscripts, and submitted content are subject to regular and additional reviews whenever suspicious activity or policy violations are identified.

We do not tolerate plagiarism, fraudulent publishing practices, mass-produced spam content, deliberate manipulation of platform systems, or repeated submission of material that fails to meet our minimum quality standards.
STRICT ORIGINALITY & ANTI-PLAGIARISM POLICY
All books submitted to Bonovela must be original works created and legally owned or controlled by the submitting author.
The following activities are strictly prohibited:
Copying another author's book, chapters, paragraphs, or manuscripts.
Rewriting or paraphrasing another person's work and presenting it as an original creation.
Translating copyrighted stories from other platforms without the necessary authorization.
Submitting books previously published by another author under a different pen name without documented ownership or publishing rights.
Reproducing copyrighted characters, storylines, or substantial portions of another person's work without permission.
Submitting stolen, purchased, or unauthorized manuscripts as original work.
Creating multiple accounts to republish rejected, banned, or previously removed books.
Changing character names, locations, titles, or minor story details does not make copied content original.
Bonovela also reserves the right to respond to legitimate copyright complaints and take appropriate action under applicable intellectual property laws.
AI-GENERATED CONTENT & AUTOMATED SPAM POLICY

Bonovela does not permit authors to use AI tools to mass-produce low-quality stories, chapters, or manuscripts for the purpose of generating artificial word counts, increasing publishing activity, or manipulating platform earnings.
Strictly prohibited activities include:
Mass-generating entire books or chapters using AI and submitting them without meaningful human authorship, development, and editorial responsibility.
Automatically generating repetitive chapters with little or no meaningful storytelling.
Publishing AI-generated filler, meaningless paragraphs, or duplicated content to increase word counts.
Using automated systems, bots, or scripts to mass-upload chapters.
Submitting multiple variations of the same AI-generated manuscript.
Using AI to imitate another author's writing or reproduce copyrighted material.
Misrepresenting AI-generated or third-party material as entirely original human-authored work.
The use of writing assistance or editing tools does not automatically constitute a violation. However, authors remain fully responsible for originality, accuracy, quality, and compliance.
Bonovela reserves the right to request manuscript drafts, writing history, outlines, or other reasonable evidence of authorship when a submission raises legitimate concerns.
MINIMUM WRITING QUALITY REQUIREMENTS
Every book published on Bonovela must maintain an acceptable standard of writing quality.
Authors are expected to provide:
Proper grammar, spelling, punctuation, and sentence structure.
Consistent character development and believable character interactions.
Meaningful plot progression and well-developed storylines.
Proper chapter organization and formatting.
Engaging storytelling without unnecessary repetition or filler.
Original descriptions, dialogue, and narrative development.
Consistent updates that maintain the quality of the manuscript.
The following may trigger editorial rejection or further investigation:
Excessively repetitive chapters.
Chapters containing meaningless or irrelevant content.
Extremely poor sentence construction that makes stories difficult to understand.
Repeatedly submitting incomplete or improperly formatted chapters.
Stories with no meaningful plot development.
Deliberate manipulation of chapter length or word counts.
Repeatedly ignoring editorial instructions and quality improvement requests.
Bonovela reserves the right to reject, suspend, restrict, or remove books that consistently fail to meet its publishing standards.
Repeated or serious violations may lead to contract termination.
WORD COUNT MANIPULATION & PLATFORM FRAUD
Bonovela strictly prohibits artificial inflation of book word counts and fraudulent attempts to qualify for platform benefits.
Authors must not:
Repeat paragraphs or chapters to increase their total word count.
Upload duplicate chapters under different chapter numbers.
Add meaningless sentences solely to meet monetization or contractual milestones.
Manipulate reading activity, reader engagement, or other platform statistics.
Use bots, fake accounts, or artificial traffic to generate earnings.
Manipulate Pay-to-Read eligibility or editorial approval processes.
Engage in fraudulent activities intended to obtain bonuses, royalties, or promotional benefits.
Any confirmed attempt to manipulate the platform's systems may result in immediate suspension of the affected book and investigation of the author's account.
Serious or repeated violations may result in contract termination and permanent exclusion from Bonovela.
PAY-TO-READ & MONETIZATION COMPLIANCE
Pay-to-Read approval is a privilege subject to editorial review and platform requirements.
Authors must not manipulate chapters, reader activity, or book content to obtain Pay-to-Read approval.
Bonovela reserves the right to:
Reject Pay-to-Read applications that fail editorial requirements.
Remove previously approved chapters from monetization when serious quality or compliance issues are identified.
Suspend monetization during an investigation.
Reverse fraudulent transactions and earnings associated with proven manipulation, subject to applicable law and contractual terms.
Terminate contracts for serious monetization fraud.
CONTENT AUDITS & EDITORIAL INVESTIGATIONS
Bonovela reserves the right to conduct routine, random, and targeted content inspections.
These inspections may cover:
Published books and chapters.
Previously approved manuscripts.
Book descriptions, titles, and promotional materials.
Originality and plagiarism concerns.
Suspicious similarities with works published elsewhere.
Unusual word count or publishing activity.
Artificial engagement and suspicious earnings.
Compliance with contractual obligations.
Where necessary, authors may be contacted and requested to provide original drafts, supporting documents, or explanations.
Refusing to cooperate with a reasonable investigation, providing falsified evidence, or attempting to obstruct an investigation may constitute an additional contractual violation.
DISCIPLINARY ACTIONS & CONTRACT TERMINATION
Bonovela reserves the right to impose disciplinary measures based on the nature, severity, frequency, and consequences of a violation.
Possible enforcement actions include:
Formal warning and request for correction.
Rejection of submitted chapters or manuscripts.
Temporary suspension of book updates.
Removal of non-compliant chapters or entire books.
Suspension or removal of Pay-to-Read privileges.
Temporary account suspension.
Withholding of disputed or fraud-related payments pending investigation, subject to applicable law and contractual terms.
Recovery of advances, bonuses, or other payments obtained through proven fraud or contractual misconduct, where legally permitted.
Immediate termination of the author's publishing contract for serious violations.
Permanent account deactivation and platform exclusion.

Bonovela reserves the right to terminate a publishing contract without offering an opportunity for revision where the violation is serious, including confirmed plagiarism, deliberate copyright infringement, publishing fraud, or repeated misconduct.

Termination does not automatically cancel legitimate payment obligations for royalties already earned. Any withholding, recovery, or forfeiture must be supported by the applicable contract, established violation, and applicable law.
PERMANENT ACCOUNT BANS, DEVICE & IP RESTRICTIONS

Authors who engage in serious misconduct, particularly plagiarism, fraudulent publishing, repeated account abuse, or deliberate attempts to evade platform restrictions, may be permanently banned from Bonovela.
Bonovela may implement appropriate security restrictions, including:
Permanent suspension of the violating account.
Blocking access to the affected publishing profile.
Restricting associated accounts involved in the same confirmed misconduct.
IP-address restrictions where necessary and technically appropriate.
Device or session restrictions where supported by the platform.
Preventing banned authors from registering new accounts to evade enforcement.
Removing unauthorized or infringing content from the platform.
Attempts to bypass a permanent ban through new accounts, different email addresses, alternative pen names, or other technical methods may result in additional restrictions.

IP addresses and device identifiers may be used as security signals, not as conclusive proof of identity or misconduct. Restrictions will be applied following appropriate review, with consideration for shared networks, VPNs, dynamic IP addresses, and legitimate users who may share devices or connections.
Where an author believes an account has been incorrectly restricted, they may submit an appeal through the designated support channel.
CONTENT REMOVAL & INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY PROTECTION
Bonovela takes intellectual property protection seriously.
Where content is confirmed to violate copyright, publishing rights, or platform policies, Bonovela reserves the right to:
Remove the affected book or chapters.
Disable access to infringing content.
Suspend related publishing activities.
Terminate the relevant publishing contract.
Restrict repeat offenders from future publishing.
Cooperate with legitimate rights holders and lawful requests from relevant authorities.
Authors are responsible for ensuring that they possess the necessary rights and permissions for all materials submitted to Bonovela.
APPEALS & REVIEW PROCESS
Bonovela recognizes that automated systems and editorial assessments may occasionally produce incorrect results.
Authors who receive disciplinary action may submit a written appeal through the appropriate support channel.
An appeal should include:
Author ID and pen name.
Book title and book ID.
A clear explanation of the disputed decision.
Relevant original manuscripts, drafts, ownership evidence, or supporting documents.
Bonovela will review appeals according to the nature of the violation and the evidence available.
Submitting an appeal does not automatically restore a suspended book, account, or contract. Restrictions may remain in place while a legitimate investigation is ongoing.
FINAL DECLARATION & AUTHOR RESPONSIBILITY

By signing a publishing contract and publishing content on Bonovela, authors acknowledge their responsibility to maintain originality, professional writing standards, and compliance with all applicable platform policies.
Bonovela is committed to protecting genuine authors, maintaining reader confidence, preventing publishing fraud, and ensuring that the platform rewards authentic creative work.
We reserve the right to review, restrict, suspend, or terminate publishing relationships where authors violate these standards.
No author is exempt from these policies, regardless of their popularity, earnings, publishing history, contract status, or relationship with any member of the editorial team.
Ignorance of the policy will not automatically excuse a violation.
BONOVELA MAINTAINS ZERO TOLERANCE FOR PLAGIARISM, FRAUDULENT PUBLISHING, DELIBERATE CONTENT MANIPULATION, AND REPEATED ABUSE OF THE PLATFORM.
By continuing to publish on Bonovela, authors agree to comply with these requirements and any applicable terms of their publishing agreements.
BONOVELA MANAGEMENT
Content Integrity & Editorial Compliance Department
